# apple_in_app_purchase_price_points (Data Source)

Lists the price points an in-app purchase can be sold at, per territory, for `apple_in_app_purchase_price_schedule`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_in_app_purchase_price_points" "usd" {
  in_app_purchase_id = apple_in_app_purchase.coins.id
  territories        = ["USA"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase.

### Optional

- `customer_prices` (Set of String) Only price points with these customer prices, e.g. `0.99`.
- `territories` (Set of String) Only price points in these territories, e.g. `USA`.

### Read-Only

- `price_points` (Attributes List) The price points. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--price_points))

<a id="nestedatt--price_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `price_points`

Read-Only:

- `customer_price` (String) Price customers pay, in the territory's currency, e.g. `0.99`.
- `id` (String) ID of the price point, for `apple_app_price_schedule`.
- `proceeds` (String) Proceeds per sale, in the territory's currency.
- `territory` (String) Territory of the price point, e.g. `USA`.
